headline_claims.claim: Within the declared positive log-linear family, current structural unidentified dimension is k-rank(M), and a new scalar observation reduces it iff its row adds a new direction outside the current row span.
headline_claims.claim_ceiling: structural identification result under the declared model family; not generic ecological causal identification

headline_claims.claim: A finite experiment induces an exact compatible-world quotient; deterministic target reporting is justified only when the target is constant over the compatible class, and only target-relevant distinctions need resolution.
headline_claims.claim_ceiling: finite declared-world target reportability; target-safe refinement is a resolution requirement, not proof that the current record already identifies the required block

headline_claims.claim: Mechanism-learning information and exact target-licensing value can rank the same equal-cost candidate observations differently.
headline_claims.claim_ceiling: exact finite divergence witness; not a universal utility or universal optimal-design theorem

headline_claims.claim: Within the frozen declared candidate family, information-guided sequential observation selection resolves residual mechanism ambiguity more efficiently than random ordering.
headline_claims.claim_ceiling: controlled truth-peek-free synthetic/known-truth validation; no universal natural-system optimality

headline_claims.claim: A nominally discriminating observation direction is not automatically trustworthy evidence; shared versus independent failure architecture changes the guarantee that can be credited to repeated observations.
headline_claims.claim_ceiling: guarantees conditional on declared failure contracts; no silent independence claim

headline_claims.claim: Mechanism-learning stop, target-licensing stop and declared-candidate exhaustion are mathematically distinct states; under a target that is a deterministic function of mechanism state, mechanism resolution implies target resolution, while the converse and the candidate-exhaustion implications fail in general.
headline_claims.claim_ceiling: exact finite compatible-world stopping relations under declared mechanism/target/candidate maps; not a universal policy-optimality theorem

non_headline_extensions.claim: An intervention can change the observation map and create a separating direction that is absent under passive observation.
non_headline_extensions.claim_ceiling: exact/structural finite-world extension only; physical intervention validity is deferred to InsePi or another empirical validation layer
